headline: Mexican Peso Closes Above 19 Units per Dollar for First Time Since June 2025
summary: The Mexican peso weakened to close above 19 per dollar after Banxico's meeting minutes were published. Markets are adjusting to expectations of a narrower rate gap with the United States.
why: The peso is Mexico's currency, and its value is closely tied to the interest rate gap set by Banco de México relative to the US Federal Reserve.
why_moved: The peso fell after Banxico's minutes, as traders priced in a smaller interest rate differential with the United States.
original_headline: Peso mexicano cierra sobre 19 unidades por dólar por primera vez desde junio de 2025
